Many processes across ecommerce, operations, customer support, finance, HR and reporting are still dependent on people manually checking data, updating spreadsheets, following up and reporting exceptions. We are actively moving these workflows toward AI-assisted and automated operations. The problem is not lack of tools. The problem is converting real business processes into reliable workflows that actually work without constant founder involvement. We are looking for someone who can own this. **Your Core Responsibility** Take a business process that is currently being done manually and convert it into a reliable AI-powered or automated workflow. You will work directly with the founder and department teams to understand processes, identify repetitive work and build systems using tools such as: - ChatGPT and ChatGPT Work - Google Sheets - Google Drive - Asana - Apps Script - n8n / Make / similar automation tools - APIs and AI tools You do not need to be a hardcore software developer. But you must be extremely strong at logic, troubleshooting and understanding how systems should work. **What You Will Actually Do** 1. Understand Existing Processes Sit with employees and understand exactly how a process currently works. Document: Input → Process → Decision → Output → Exception → Escalation Do not automate a process you don't understand. 2. Build AI Workflows Convert repetitive activities into workflows. Examples could include: - Marketplace listing hygiene audits - Amazon case monitoring - Customer support audits - Asana task audits - Inventory exception reporting - Returns and claims verification - Daily/weekly MIS - Spreadsheet reconciliation - Employee follow-up systems - Vendor and purchase tracking - Email monitoring and classification 3. Write Reliable AI Instructions Create detailed instructions for AI agents and ChatGPT Work tasks. The instructions must clearly define: - What needs to happen - Which data should be used - What the AI is allowed to modify - What it must never modify - Validation rules - Exception handling - Recovery from failures - When human approval is required - How execution should be logged 4. Test Before Deployment Never deploy an automation simply because it worked once. Test normal cases, incorrect data, missing data, duplicates, unusual cases and system failures. For workflows that modify business data, accuracy is more important than speed. 5. Monitor Automations Maintain a central AI Automation Master containing: Process | Department | Owner | Automation | Frequency | Data Source | Write Access | Risk Level | Last Run | Success/Failure | Exception Failed automations must be investigated and fixed. 6. Reduce Founder Dependency Your biggest responsibility is not simply creating automations. It is reducing the amount of operational work that reaches the founder. Before automation: Employee → Founder → Decision After automation: Employee/System → AI Workflow → Exception → Founder only when necessary **What We Are Looking For** You should be comfortable with: - ChatGPT and AI agents - Advanced Google Sheets - Logical formulas and data validation - Basic Google Apps Script - APIs - Automation tools such as n8n or Make - Understanding structured data - Debugging failed workflows Ecommerce experience is useful but not mandatory. **The Most Important Skill** Structured thinking. If somebody explains a messy business process to you for 20 minutes, you should be able to convert it into a clear workflow. We care more about this than degrees or certifications. You Are Probably NOT Right for This Role If * You mainly use ChatGPT for writing emails or content. * You copy prompts from the internet without understanding why they work. * You need detailed instructions for every step. * You stop when an automation fails instead of investigating why. * You automate processes without understanding the underlying business logic. Success in the First 90 Days **We expect you to:** - Map the major repetitive workflows across the company. - Build a prioritized Automation Master. - Deploy multiple reliable AI/automation workflows. - Establish testing and failure-monitoring systems. - Reduce repetitive founder supervision substantially. Our target is to eliminate 50–100 hours per month of repetitive operational work and supervision. **How We Will Evaluate Candidates** This role will have a practical assignment. Instead of asking theoretical AI questions, we will give you an actual business process. You will need to: 1. Understand the process. 2. Identify problems and risks. 3. Design the workflow. 4. Decide what should and should not be automated. 5. Build a working prototype. 6. Explain how you would prevent the automation from making incorrect changes. If you enjoy taking messy operations and turning them into systems that run reliably, this role will suit you. Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month Application Question(s): * Have you worked on automating any business process using AI tools such as ChatGPT, n8n, Make,etc., or using Google Sheets/Google Apps Script? Work Location: Remote

India is the world's second-largest producer of fruits and vegetables, and loses over a lakh crore rupees of it every year between the farm and the shelf. Fresh Platter exists to fix that – not with an app, but by running the supply chain ourselves and engineering every step of it. We are hiring software engineers to build the brains of that system. **About Fresh Platter** Fresh Platter is a technology-driven fresh-produce supply-chain company, founded in Bengaluru in 2022. Every day we source from farms, then ripen, grade, pack and deliver fresh produce, using technology and data to improve quality, ensure consistent supply, minimise wastage and bring predictability to pricing. Around 100 people run the chain end to end, and the business is profitable. We are also building our own machines and systems, because the bottlenecks we find in our operations cannot be fixed with software alone. Our harvest-handling rig cut bruising from around 30% to around 3%. Systems for farm selection, field scanning, produce movement and a fully automated packhouse are in build and design, with IISc and partner engineering firms. Five patent applications are filed. Everything is built in three layers: a physical layer that moves and conditions produce, a sensing layer that reads its state, and an intelligence layer that decides what happens next and learns from the result. The crop changes. The architecture stays. **The role** We are building a high-quality software engineering team to own the sensing and intelligence layers, and the applications that run the business around them. You will join an existing team under our Tech Manager, and you will be expected to raise its bar, not just fill a seat. We build with a new generation of AI-assisted development tools, seriously and every day. A small, sharp team here ships what used to need a large one. We will train you from your first week. If you already use these tools, good. If you have never touched one, that is fine – what we need is the raw ability to learn fast, think clearly and get things done. **What you will build** **Machines and sensing** • The software that configures and controls our machines – reading their sensors, turning that data into decisions, and sending the right instructions back. • The data path from sensor to screen: collection, storage, monitoring and alerts. • Prototype-to-production work with our mechanical engineers, IISc and partner teams, tested on real machines in a real packhouse. **Products and applications** • The applications that run the chain: farm sourcing and procurement, ripening, grading and packing, inventory, logistics, quality and farm-to-customer traceability. • Dashboards and alerts so teams see problems as they happen, not in next month's report. • Integrations with the systems we already run – accounting, projects, mail and messaging – so data is captured once and flows wherever it is needed. **AI-driven automation** • Automation of the repetitive work across procurement, accounts and operations – checking purchase orders and vendor bills against their supporting documents, reconciliations, reporting and follow-ups. • AI agents that read documents, emails and system records, decide what to do and act on it, with a person approving where it matters. **Engineering practice** • Own what you ship after it goes live – monitoring, fixes and improvements. • Work across the stack: front end, back end, APIs, databases, device communication and data pipelines. • Write tests, review code, deploy safely and document what you build. • If you join with experience, help set the team's engineering standards and mentor the engineers who join after you. **Who we are looking for** • B.E. or B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication, Electronics and Telecommunication, Electrical and Electronics, or a closely related engineering stream. • 0 to 4 years of experience. Freshers with a strong academic record and engineers who have shipped production software are both welcome. Title and responsibility will match experience. • Solid programming fundamentals and problem-solving skills in at least one language. • A working understanding of databases, web applications and APIs, and the ability to debug code you did not write. • Someone who learns fast, goes deep rather than skimming, works around obstacles and stays steady when priorities change – humble enough to be trained from scratch, confident enough to question what does not make sense. • You do not need to be from a top-tier college. **What to know before you apply** This is an on-site role at our facility in Cheemasandra, Bengaluru East, six days a week, with no remote or hybrid option – the machines you will work on are here. The team is lean, problems rarely arrive with neat specifications, and the hours are long. This is not a comfortable job. It is the fastest way we know to become an exceptionally capable engineer. **Why join us** • Your code runs real machines and a real supply chain the moment it is ready – no release queues, no waiting months to see your work in use. • Patented systems co-developed with IISc and engineering firms, not another CRUD app. • Learn AI-assisted development in your first job, not your fifth. • Real ownership from your first month, working close to a founder who spent 18+ years in software and data systems before building this company. • Grow as fast as you can prove yourself. We hire on potential and promote on delivery. **What success looks like** • Within 3 months, you are shipping features to production on your own. • Within 6 months, you own one or more of our products end to end. • Within 12 months, you can take any problem in the business and build the software that solves it. **The details** • Location: Cheemasandra, Bengaluru East, Karnataka • Work mode: On-site, six days a week • Employment type: Full-time • Experience: 0 to 4 years (freshers welcome) • Openings: Up to 2 • Reports to: Tech Manager

**Job Summary** As a Software Development Engineer II in the Trust Engineering team at JioHotstar, you will build scalable and reliable systems that help keep our platform, users, content, and ecosystem safe and trustworthy. You will work on backend services and platform capabilities that detect, prevent, and mitigate abuse, fraud, policy violations, and other trust-related risks at scale. You will work closely with product, data science, security, and engineering teams to design and implement solutions that balance user experience, platform integrity, and operational efficiency. The role involves solving complex engineering problems across high-throughput systems, real-time decisioning, data processing, and distributed services. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving challenging backend problems, working with large-scale systems, and building technology that directly impacts the safety and integrity of a consumer platform. **About The Team** The Trust Engineering team at JioHotstar works at the intersection of engineering, security, data, and user experience to build a safe and trusted streaming ecosystem. With hundreds of millions of users consuming content across multiple platforms, maintaining trust at scale requires robust systems for identifying suspicious activity, preventing abuse, protecting platform integrity, and enabling responsible user experiences. The team works on a broad range of engineering challenges, including real-time risk detection, fraud and abuse prevention, account and identity protection, policy enforcement, automated decisioning, and trust-related platform services. You’ll have the opportunity to work on large-scale systems where engineering decisions have a direct impact on millions of users. If you enjoy building scalable backend systems, solving ambiguous problems, and working on technology that has a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and systems for Trust and Safety use cases. * Build systems for detecting, preventing, and mitigating abuse, fraud, suspicious activity, and other platform risks. * Develop real-time and batch processing capabilities to identify and respond to trust-related signals. * Work with large-scale datasets and event streams to build reliable risk detection and decisioning systems. * Design APIs, services, and data pipelines that support trust, safety, and platform integrity workflows. * Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Security, and other Engineering teams to translate business and trust requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Build reliable systems with strong focus on performance, availability, scalability, and data quality. * Investigate production issues, identify root causes, and implement long-term solutions. * Develop monitoring, alerting, and operational mechanisms to ensure reliability of trust systems. * Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and engineering best-practice initiatives. * Continuously evaluate and adopt technologies that improve the scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of Trust Engineering systems. Skills and Attributes for Success * Strong programming experience in Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, or similar backend languages. * Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and software engineering fundamentals. * Hands-on experience building backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. * Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases and understanding of data modeling. * Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies is preferred. * Understanding of distributed systems, caching, asynchronous processing, and microservices architecture. * Strong debugging, problem-solving, and performance-tuning skills. * Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. * Familiarity with monitoring, logging, alerting, and production troubleshooting. * Understanding of security, privacy, authentication, authorization, or risk systems is a plus. * Exposure to fraud detection, abuse prevention, Trust & Safety, identity, risk management, or security engineering is preferred. * Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and operate in a fast-paced environment. **Preferred Education And Experience** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 2–5 years of experience in backend/software engineering, preferably working on large-scale consumer or platform systems. * Experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems. * Experience in Trust & Safety, Fraud/Risk, Security, Identity, or similar domains is a strong plus. **About JioStar** Perched at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of millions of people across geographies. JioStar is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. The company ensures that the work environment is free from any discrimination against persons with disabilities, gender, gender identity, and any other characteristics or status that is legally protected.

description: Company: **Midad Arabia** Job Title: **ERP QA Tester** – **Accounting & Finance Specialist** Department: **Quality Assurance / Software Testing** Experience: **Entry-level** (Freshers can apply) Employment Type: **Full-time** **1.⁠ ⁠About Midad Arabia** Midad Arabia provides ERP solutions and business software that help companies improve operational efficiency, manage their finances, and increase profitability. We are looking for a motivated ERP QA Tester with strong accounting fundamentals and an interest in software testing to ensure our ERP system is accurate, reliable, and ready for real-world business use. **2.⁠ ⁠Job Summary** We are looking for an entry-level ERP QA Tester who combines accounting knowledge with software testing skills. The ideal candidate should understand basic accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, financial statements, taxation, inventory accounting, and business workflows. The candidate will test ERP modules, validate accounting entries generated by business transactions, identify software defects and financial discrepancies, and ensure that business processes function correctly. The successful candidate will receive opportunities to develop expertise in ERP testing, accounting validation, and end-to-end business process testing. **3.⁠ ⁠Key Responsibilities** **A. ERP Software Testing** * Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing of ERP modules. * Prepare test cases, test scenarios, and test data. * Identify software bugs, calculation errors, workflow failures, and data inconsistencies. * Test positive, negative, and exceptional scenarios. * Verify that business processes work correctly across interconnected modules. * Retest defects after fixes and perform regression testing. * Maintain clear test documentation and report testing progress. **B. Accounting and Finance Validation** * Verify debit and credit entries generated by ERP transactions. * Test General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Trial Balance, Profit and Loss, and Balance Sheet reports. * Validate journal entries, opening balances, accruals, prepayments, and depreciation. * Test customer invoices, vendor bills, credit notes, debit notes, receipts, payments, and payment vouchers. * Ensure customer and vendor balances reconcile with the General Ledger. * Validate tax calculations, discounts, rounding, and tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive pricing. * Test bank reconciliation, outstanding payments, and financial period closing. * Identify duplicate entries, missing postings, incorrect balances, and financial reporting discrepancies. **C. End-to-End ERP Workflow Testing** * Test complete business processes, including: * Sales: Quotation → Sales Order → Delivery → Customer Invoice → Receipt → Accounting Entries. * Purchases: Purchase Order → Goods Receipt Note (GRN) → Vendor Bill → Payment → Accounting Entries. * Inventory: Stock receipts, deliveries, returns, stock adjustments, transfers, costing, and valuation. * Accounts: Journal entries, receivables, payables, cash and bank management, and financial reporting. * Returns: Sales returns, purchase returns, credit notes, refunds, and related inventory and accounting adjustments. * Period Closing: Inventory valuation, depreciation, accruals, tax reconciliation, and financial statement verification. **D. Bug Reporting and Team Collaboration** * Report bugs with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, expected results, and actual results. * Classify defects based on severity and business impact. * Work closely with developers, product managers, and implementation teams. * Investigate accounting discrepancies and assist in identifying their root causes. * Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and validate fixes before release. * Communicate critical defects and financial risks to the team. **4.⁠ ⁠Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Information Systems, or a related field. * Fresh graduates and candidates with 0–2 years of experience are welcome to apply. * Strong understanding of basic accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, debit and credit entries, and financial statements. * Basic knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing, payments, and bank reconciliation. * Strong interest in software testing, quality assurance, and ERP systems. * Basic understanding of software testing concepts, including test cases, bug reporting, and functional testing, is an advantage. * Good analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills. * Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies in financial data. * Willingness to learn ERP workflows, testing methodologies, and accounting processes. * Good written and verbal communication skills. **Preferred**: Basic knowledge of ERP software such as Odoo, SAP, Zoho, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms is an advantage. Familiarity with SQL, Postman, Jira, or other testing tools is also beneficial but not mandatory. Important: Strong accounting fundamentals and analytical ability are essential. Previous professional ERP testing experience is not mandatory, as training will be provided to the right candidate. **5.⁠ ⁠Technical Skills to Develop** * The candidate will be expected to learn and develop skills in: * Manual testing and end-to-end workflow testing. * Functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing. * SQL and database validation for investigating transaction discrepancies. * Bug tracking and documentation using Jira or equivalent tools. * API testing using tools such as Postman. * Automation testing using Selenium, Playwright, or similar tools, where required. **6.⁠ ⁠Ideal Candidate Profile** * The ideal candidate should be able to: * Understand whether an ERP transaction is correct from an accounting perspective. * Trace a transaction from its source document through inventory movements, accounting entries, and financial reports. * Identify financial errors that a regular software tester might overlook. * Compare system-generated balances against independently calculated expected results. * Understand how a change in one module affects other modules. * Approach problems logically and document findings clearly. * Take responsibility for software quality and the accuracy of financial data. **7.⁠ ⁠Salary and Probation Structure** * First 6 Months – Probation Period: ₹7,000 per month. ( Rupees INR) * Next 6 Months – Salary: ₹10,000 per month, subject to successful completion of the probation period and satisfactory performance.( Rupees INR) * Salary Revision: After completion of the first 1 year, salary will be reviewed based on performance, ERP testing skills, accounting knowledge, quality of work, and overall contribution to the company. * The candidate is expected to demonstrate continuous improvement in ERP testing capabilities, accounting accuracy, and independent handling of testing responsibilities throughout these periods. **8.⁠ ⁠Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** * Accuracy and completeness of test cases. * Ability to identify critical software and accounting defects before production. * Effectiveness of regression and end-to-end testing. * Accuracy of financial reconciliation and expected-result calculations. * Quality of bug reports and retesting. * Reduction in production defects and customer-reported financial errors. * Ability to test interconnected ERP workflows independently. **9.⁠ ⁠Application Requirements** Applicants should submit their CV along with details of their educational qualifications, accounting knowledge, software testing experience (if any), and familiarity with ERP platforms. Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical assessment involving accounting transactions, financial reconciliation, ERP workflow testing, and software defect identification. Join Midad Arabia and build your career at the intersection of accounting, ERP systems, and software quality assurance. Pay: ₹7,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month Work Location: Remote

**Company:** Allo Innoware **Location:** Mumbai / Remote **Job Type:** Full-time **Reports To:** Founder **Why We Are Hiring** Allo Innoware is scaling its ecommerce operations across marketplaces and D2C. Many processes across ecommerce, operations, customer support, finance, HR and reporting are still dependent on people manually checking data, updating spreadsheets, following up and reporting exceptions. We are actively moving these workflows toward AI-assisted and automated operations. The problem is not lack of tools. The problem is converting real business processes into reliable workflows that actually work without constant founder involvement. We are looking for someone who can own this. **Your Core Responsibility** Take a business process that is currently being done manually and convert it into a reliable AI-powered or automated workflow. You will work directly with the founder and department teams to understand processes, identify repetitive work and build systems using tools such as: - ChatGPT and ChatGPT Work - Google Sheets - Google Drive - Asana - Apps Script - n8n / Make / similar automation tools - APIs and AI tools You do not need to be a hardcore software developer. But you must be extremely strong at logic, troubleshooting and understanding how systems should work. **What You Will Actually Do** 1. Understand Existing Processes Sit with employees and understand exactly how a process currently works. Document: Input → Process → Decision → Output → Exception → Escalation Do not automate a process you don't understand. 2. Build AI Workflows Convert repetitive activities into workflows. Examples could include: - Marketplace listing hygiene audits - Amazon case monitoring - Customer support audits - Asana task audits - Inventory exception reporting - Returns and claims verification - Daily/weekly MIS - Spreadsheet reconciliation - Employee follow-up systems - Vendor and purchase tracking - Email monitoring and classification 3. Write Reliable AI Instructions Create detailed instructions for AI agents and ChatGPT Work tasks. The instructions must clearly define: - What needs to happen - Which data should be used - What the AI is allowed to modify - What it must never modify - Validation rules - Exception handling - Recovery from failures - When human approval is required - How execution should be logged 4. Test Before Deployment Never deploy an automation simply because it worked once. Test normal cases, incorrect data, missing data, duplicates, unusual cases and system failures. For workflows that modify business data, accuracy is more important than speed. 5. Monitor Automations Maintain a central AI Automation Master containing: Process | Department | Owner | Automation | Frequency | Data Source | Write Access | Risk Level | Last Run | Success/Failure | Exception Failed automations must be investigated and fixed. 6. Reduce Founder Dependency Your biggest responsibility is not simply creating automations. It is reducing the amount of operational work that reaches the founder. Before automation: Employee → Founder → Decision After automation: Employee/System → AI Workflow → Exception → Founder only when necessary **What We Are Looking For** You should be comfortable with: - ChatGPT and AI agents - Advanced Google Sheets - Logical formulas and data validation - Basic Google Apps Script - APIs - Automation tools such as n8n or Make - Understanding structured data - Debugging failed workflows Ecommerce experience is useful but not mandatory. **The Most Important Skill** Structured thinking. If somebody explains a messy business process to you for 20 minutes, you should be able to convert it into a clear workflow. We care more about this than degrees or certifications. You Are Probably NOT Right for This Role If * You mainly use ChatGPT for writing emails or content. * You copy prompts from the internet without understanding why they work. * You need detailed instructions for every step. * You stop when an automation fails instead of investigating why. * You automate processes without understanding the underlying business logic. Success in the First 90 Days **We expect you to:** - Map the major repetitive workflows across the company. - Build a prioritized Automation Master. - Deploy multiple reliable AI/automation workflows. - Establish testing and failure-monitoring systems. - Reduce repetitive founder supervision substantially. Our target is to eliminate 50–100 hours per month of repetitive operational work and supervision. **How We Will Evaluate Candidates** This role will have a practical assignment. Instead of asking theoretical AI questions, we will give you an actual business process. You will need to: 1. Understand the process. 2. Identify problems and risks. 3. Design the workflow. 4. Decide what should and should not be automated. 5. Build a working prototype. 6. Explain how you would prevent the automation from making incorrect changes. If you enjoy taking messy operations and turning them into systems that run reliably, this role will suit you. Work Location: Remote Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month Work Location: Remote

Observability operational automation: Build and configure effective monitoring and observability capabilities, including dashboards, monitors, alerting and integrations, while introducing opportunities for automated remediation and self-healing.
